Why should red wine not have equal rights?

Red wine doesn’t need “equal rights” because it isn’t a person or legal entity—it’s a beverage. But if you mean equal treatment with white wine, it deserves an equal place on the menu, subject only to taste, food pairing, and responsible alcohol rules.
